newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen 91-day treasury bills average 19.02 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yemen 91-day treasury bills average 19.02 pct.

text.p: The Central Bank of Yemen said on Tuesday its latest issue of 91-day treasury bills yielded an average 19.02 percent, down from the average 19.47 percent at the March 23 auction.
Of the six billion rials worth of bills on offer the issue attracted subscriptions worth 5.28 billion rials.

The average price was 9,593 rials and the lowest price accepted was was 9,526.90 rials. Yields ranged from 17.02 percent to 19.91 percent. The latest issue of 182-day bills yielded an average 19.66 percent from 20.97 percent at the last auction. Of the two billion rials worth of 182-day bills on offer, the issue attracted 1.94 billion rials.
The average price was 9,107 rials and the lowest price accepted was 9,070 rials. Yields ranged from 17.75 percent to 20.56 percent.
The latest issue of 346-day bills yielded an average of 19.83 percent from 20.71 percent from the March 23 auction.

Of the one billion rials worth of the 346-day bills on offer, the issue attracted 970 million rials. The average price was 8,348.81 rials and the lowest price accepted was 8,268.35 rials. Yields ranged from 17.75 percent to 21 percent. The bank did not fix a date for the next auction.
